text:
A car tyre runs over a nail that makes a hole in it. The air in the tyre leaks out.
air
Why does the air leave the tyre?
A
The pressure inside the tyre is greater than the pressure outside.
B
The pressure inside the tyre is less than the pressure outside.
C
The temperature inside the tyre is greater than the temperature outside.
D
The temperature inside the tyre is less than the temperature outside

options.label: A
options.text: The pressure inside the tyre is greater than the pressure outside.

options.label: B
options.text: The pressure inside the tyre is less than the pressure outside.

options.label: C
options.text: The temperature inside the tyre is greater than the temperature outside.

options.label: D
options.text: The temperature inside the tyre is less than the temperature outside
